chunks: And whatever was in it from ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdūs al-Naysābūrī, I have narrated it from him.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; indicates direct transmission by the author.
key_terms.عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَ: A named transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.عَنْهُ: From him; marks the source of transmission.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdūs al-Naysābūrī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies a transmission link in the sanad/isnad of the book. The author states that the material attributed to ʿAbd al-Wāḥid ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbdūs al-Naysābūrī was narrated directly from him.
